input: Draft a packing list for a backpacking trip

gold.taskTitle: Draft a Packing List for a Backpacking Trip
gold.taskDescription: Create a complete and personalised packing list for an upcoming backpacking trip.

questions.title: How many days will the trip last?
questions.description: Understand the duration of the trip to determine quantities of clothing, food, and supplies needed.

questions.title: What is the destination climate or terrain?
questions.description: Identify whether the environment is tropical, alpine, desert, forest, etc. to tailor gear and clothing choices.

questions.title: What time of year will you be travelling?
questions.description: Determine the season to account for temperature ranges, rain, snow, or heat.

questions.title: Will you be sleeping in tents, shelters, or hostels?
questions.description: Clarify accommodation type to know whether to include sleeping gear, bedding, or locks.

questions.title: Are you travelling solo or with a group?
questions.description: Know whether shared gear like cooking equipment or first aid can be split across travellers.

questions.title: Do you have any medical or dietary needs to pack for?
questions.description: Identify prescription medications, allergy supplies, dietary restrictions, or special health equipment to include.

questions.title: What is your target backpack weight or size limit?
questions.description: Understand any weight or volume constraints so the list can be optimised for ultralight or standard packing.
